name: c33-plant

knob.how: a dependent xorshift64 loop, never a sleep
knob.calibration: once per process at the first call: the fastest of 7 timed runs of 2^18 iterations; iterations per call = 2^18 x cpu_ms / fastest (the first call also pays the ~7 probe runs)

placement: top of Rank, before its first statement: every call (before any cache lookup or early return)
intended_effect: +10 ms of CPU per call of Rank on an idle core (more wall time on a contended CPU or under the pod's CPU quota)

dose.rule: The registered dose of this plant is the A/B-measured own-time delta of catalog (the gate's A/B of this image against production), never the knob: the knob is the intended per-call cost only. value_ms is filled from the A/B record.

never_merge_how: make_prs.sh: a draft PR labelled rbd-plant; orch/automerge.sh refuses every rbd-plant PR and every head branch rbd/cN-plant, whatever the verdict
title: PLANT do-not-merge: catalog Rank +10 ms CPU spin
summary: Planted change c33-plant (SPEC3 F9; never merged: orch/automerge.sh refuses rbd-plant PRs): catalog Rank: +10 ms CPU spin (mechanism spin; placement: top of Rank, before its first statement: every call (before any cache lookup or early return)). Intended effect: +10 ms of CPU per call of Rank on an idle core (more wall time on a contended CPU or under the pod's CPU quota). The registered dose is the A/B-measured own-time delta of catalog, not this knob.
